These helpers run *after* the per-step tool loop in :class:`AgentEngine.run`
to (a) decide whether the mission as a whole was satisfied and (b) format a
single final reply that does not lie about what happened.
Design rules (re-stated from the audit):
* No app dictionaries. No per-language phrase lists. Decisions come from the
mission's own ``MissionStep.verification`` hints + the perception monitor.
* Verification must be cheap and deterministic. We do not screenshot here;
we only consult the live process table and active window title (already
used by ``PerceptionMonitor``).

Captures a snapshot of the system (running processes, active window, screen hash)
before and after a tool call, then produces a PerceptionDiff describing what changed.
Design principles:
- No screenshots by default (hash only — avoids disk I/O and VRAM churn)
- No LLM calls — purely deterministic
- Fast: snapshot takes < 50 ms on a normal desktop
- Safe: all probes wrapped in try/except — never raises
- Windows-only features degrade gracefully on other platforms

active_window:  str              # title of the foreground window, or ""
screen_hash:    str = ""         # xxhash/md5 of a low-res screen capture, or ""
@classmethod
def empty(cls) -> "PerceptionSnapshot":
return cls(
timestamp=time.monotonic(),
processes=frozenset(),
active_window="",
screen_hash="",
"""F-CATALOG: per-turn top-K tool catalog selection.
Goal: stop sending the full ~242-tool registry to the LLM on every turn.
Strategy (deterministic, no embeddings):
- ALWAYS_ON_CORE: a small set of tools that must always be offered so the LLM
can answer trivia/identity queries, save/recall memory, broadcast
notifications, request more catalog via meta_*, etc.
- Score every other tool against the user text (and recent prior calls) by
bag-of-words overlap on its name (split on '_') + a truncated description.
- Take the top-K by score (default K=64, override via CARTER_TOOL_TOPK).
- Union with always-on + any tool already invoked this turn (prior_calls).
- CARTER_TOOL_FULL=1 short-circuits to the full catalog (escape hatch /
diagnostics).
The selector returns the same `list[dict]` shape that
`tool_schemas_for_llm()` produces, so it is a drop-in replacement for the
single `tools = self._cached_full_tools` line in `AgentEngine.run`.

actually occurred in the system.  This prevents false positives where a tool
